summary: Schedule a Node.js Immediate in the check phase after I/O callbacks, preserving FIFO queue semantics and handle identity.

target.notes: Queue in the Node check-phase Immediate queue and return an Immediate handle.

semantics.arguments: extra arguments are passed to callback
semantics.callback_this: ordinary function receives the Immediate handle as this

caveats: setImmediate is not equivalent to Task.Run or ThreadPool scheduling.
Relative ordering versus a top-level zero-delay setTimeout is context-dependent and must not be hard-coded.
